answer: An agent marketplace serving a garden, a juniper nursery, and an oasis allocates jobs in proportion to escrowed stake, with each unit of stake counted only once. Stake stays locked for 30 days after bidding, so creating 1,000 identities merely divides the attacker's existing weight. To capture more allocation, the attacker must acquire and lock more capital, paying financing costs or giving up its use elsewhere throughout the lock.
